about: The username TapTurf gives an account, made from the name on it and nothing else. lib/account/assigned.ts (npm run test:account: assignUsername) and 20261128_usernames_assigned.sql (scripts/sql-tests/usernames_assigned.check.mjs: private.username_from_name and private.username_assign) must agree on every one. name: the account's name. emails: every address the account holds, read only to make sure the name is not one of them. taken: usernames someone has, had, or is waiting to choose. want: the username given. Made-up people only.
